items.title: IBM MQ修補兩個重大漏洞，包含可能導致遠端執行任意程式碼的CVSS滿分漏洞
items.summary: IBM於9月10日與17日先後發布兩份資安公告，修補訊息中介軟體IBM MQ的兩個重大漏洞CVE-2026-10747與CVE-2026-10858，分別影響IBM MQ Appliance 9.4及10.0部分版本，以及IBM MQ for HPE NonStop的8.1.0到8.1.0.40等版本，其中MQ Appliance應升級至已修補的9.4.0.26、9.4.5.3或

items.title: OpenAI公布GPT-6 Sol、Luna，價格較前代降低一半
items.summary: 繼頂級的Astra後，OpenAI周二（9/22）宣布GPT-6 Sol及輕量模型GPT-6 Luna，成為GPT-6家族最新成員。 OpenAI隨著快取和推論能力的提升，使其得以更低成本提供強大模型功能，Sol和Luna的API價格皆較GPT-5.6版降一半。其中Sol每百萬token輸入/輸出價格由4/20美元降為2/10美元，Luna則從0.2/1.2降為0.1和0.5美元。

items.title: 針對CRA開源責任，OpenSSF以三類角色協助開源社群判斷義務
items.summary: 歐盟《網路韌性法案》（CRA）陸續進入實施階段，不同開源軟體參與者究竟需要承擔哪些責任，也成為開源社群關注的問題。開源安全基金會（OpenSSF）9月15日推出「Grow CRA Readiness」CRA準備指南，協助開源社群判斷自身義務，依三種角色提供相應的準備路徑與資源。

items.title: Anthropic推出Claude Opus 5.5，AI越界行為減少85%
items.summary: Anthropic周二（9/22）推出新一代旗艦AI模型Claude Opus 5.5，為Claude 5.5系列首款模型，不只效能與成本有所改善，在一項新的安全評估中，試圖突破限制邊界的行為也較Opus 5及Claude Mythos 5.1減少約85%。

items.title: Google發布Chrome 154，修補108個漏洞
items.summary: 9月22日Google發布Chrome大改版154，總共修補108個資安漏洞，其中有11個重大等級、25個是高風險等級。

items.title: MongoDB修補14個漏洞，包含可能導致刪除資料與破壞記憶體的重大漏洞
items.summary: 資料庫軟體業者MongoDB於9月18日及19日陸續揭露並修補14個資安漏洞，包含兩個重大漏洞，涵蓋Mongoid、MongoDB C Driver及Entity Framework Core Provider等元件，使用者應依所採用元件升級至修補版本，其中Mongoid應更新至7.6.2、8.0.13、8.1.13、9.0.12或9.1.1以上版本，Windows平臺C Driver則應更新至1.30.11或2.5.4以上版本。

items.title: test(gateway): await abort event publication
items.summary: test(gateway): await abort event publication The abort RPC can acknowledge before the coalesced sessions.changed event has finished its asynchronous row preparation. The default one-second poll races that publication under CPU and SQLite contention. Join the existing event publisher, then use a response on the same WebSocket to observe its queued frames before checking the unchanged event assertion. The unauthorized-abort negative witness and all cancellation checks stay intact. No retry, timeout increase, or production contract change. CI sighting: run 35814249161, job 107032499693. Blacksmith Testbox proof used two-CPU affinity plus a busy process. Before: 1/3 standalone runs failed and the original 79-file shard reproduced the missing event. After: 20/20 standalone runs at eight workers passed all 140 target cases; the target passed all seven cases in each of three original-shard replays at the CI two-worker setting, with no skips. One full candidate shard passed 1122/1122 cases. The second passed 1120/1122, with separate dispatch-rejection and chat-b failures. The third passed 1099/1125: sessions.create, permission-root, and permissions-hooks failed with revoked history reads, closing database resources, and canonical-key migration errors. Those sibling failures remain recorded; no passing rerun is claimed as a repair. The dispatch fixture is being repaired separately and the history-lifetime failures belong to the existing lane. Single-worker file cost: 59.485 seconds wall. Changed checks, type-aware lint with a rejecting canary, formatting, whitespace checks, and P2 review passed. Existing observable authorization and publication coverage is retained; no cases or process boots were added.

items.title: fix(test): supply pane identity to footer scroll fixture
items.summary: fix(test): supply pane identity to footer scroll fixture The footer-clamp regression table added in #152665 omitted the required ChatTranscriptController pane-id callback. Its options object was used as a function, failing six cases in Node and Bun plus the UI chat type graph. Supply the existing per-case fixture identity and retain every assertion. Proof: all six original failures reproduced on main; all 123 existing scroll-ownership cases pass in 3.89s wall after the repair. The UI chat type graph passes in 48.92s and targeted typed lint passes in 7.57s. Independent managed review found no actionable issue. No product code or test budget changes.

items.title: fix(test): include limit helper in packaging harness
items.summary: fix(test): include limit helper in packaging harness The trusted checkout fixture copied package-changelog.mjs without its new check-limits.mts dependency, so CLI startup failed before argument parsing in Windows CI. Copy the Node-built-in-only helper into the same fixture, preserving its no-installed-dependencies and missing-module assertions. Validation: the unchanged full file reproduces the missing helper on main with 63 passing tests, one failure, and three skips. With this fixture repair, all 64 applicable tests pass on a Linux Blacksmith Testbox (Node 24.19.0; pnpm test --maxWorkers=1 wall 20.44s, Vitest 19.38s). Native Windows CI confirmation remains separate. The complete changed-file gate passes. Managed P2 review reports scoped-clean.
